_comment: GAME PACK -- an example. Copy to games/<game>.json and edit. A pack describes WHAT THE GAME IS, so it can be shared between streamers: an optional icon map, and the Twitch categories it matches. Selected automatically when the VOD's Twitch category matches twitch_games, or forced with --game.
name: example
title: Example Game
_twitch_games_note: Exact Twitch category names. Used to auto-pick this pack from VOD metadata.
_icon_map_note: Path to an icons/<game>/map.json, or null to skip the icons stage with a notice. See icons/README.md for the format.
